ambiguities: PRB-008: FLT-8 says applying the filter "shall not move the focus", but FLT-3 says a commit with one visible card focuses that card. I read FLT-3 as the specific rule for the commit.

PRB-025: FOC-1 keeps focus on a card that "came back" in the same change. It is not stated whether a card that moves to another column and then returns counts as the same part. I read it as the same card.
PRB-042: the Card.Ready face says an off toggle in Labels.Full is "disabled", while LBL-1 says it "does nothing". I read these as the same behaviour.
PRB-023: CRY-3 does not say whether a pointer exactly at a card's middle counts as "above" it. I counted that card as not above.
Notice actions: BLK says a notice has at most one action, but Notice.Error always shows "Dismiss" beside its own action. I did not count "Dismiss" as an action for the questions asked.
PRB-050: the package does not state the history depth at a start. I took the depth at a direct start to be 1.
SCN-DSC-1 sends change-comment-text while focus is in the description field, which the WEB-4 binding does not allow. I treated that step as having no effect.
contradictions: SCN-MOV-2 expects focus on place title after dismiss-notice, but NTC-6 names no focus change, the frame rule says a rule changes only what it names, and FOC-1 keeps focus on the card that is still shown (SCN-MOV-2 'Then focus place title' vs NTC-6 and FOC-1).
FLT-8 says applying the filter "shall not move the focus", while FLT-3 applies the same filter on commit and focuses the one visible card.

CRD-1 requests comments that were "not loaded in this session", which would include a failed load, but PRP-2 says an arrival does not send a failed request again, and SCN-CRD-3 expects loadComments to stay at 1 after reopening SL-120.
BLK says "A notice has at most one action", but the Notice.Error face shows "Retry" plus "Dismiss", and SCN-CMT-2 says "with no action" and then "Then action 'Dismiss' is shown".
